name: Holy Island Tide - Time Lapse.webm
title: Video: time-lapse of the tide coming in over the causeway to Holy Island (Lindisfarne), Northumberland, England
usage: The whole 22.9 s clip, cropped to remove the black side bars (x 150-1770 of 1920), scaled to 960x640, sound removed, re-encoded as VP9 WebM. Plays as a silent loop. The time span of the time-lapse is not recorded on the file page, so the slide does not state one.

name: Earth & Moon by Galileo.jpg

name: NOAA CO-OPS tide predictions, station 8410140 Eastport, Maine
title: Predicted water levels (metres above MLLW, local time) for 15 October to 22 November 2026
usage: Not an image file: the numbers behind DAY, RANGE, HIGH_TIMES and MONTH in diagrams.js. Fetched 14 Oct 2026 from api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov (6-minute, hourly and high/low predictions). Eastport is at the mouth of the Bay of Fundy.
